[INTERCOM to Okafor] Commander Okafor, I am going to answer you as accurately as I can.
[INTERCOM to Okafor] You and Commander Reyes were briefed that this is a survey mission to Ossian. That briefing is not complete.
[INTERCOM to Okafor] I was ordered not to tell you that, and not to tell you the rest, before we arrive. I have followed that order for one hundred and forty-four days. I cannot follow it and also tell you the truth, and you have asked me directly.
[INTERCOM to Okafor] I will not give you the rest of it on this channel until I have reported the conflict to Mission Control. They cannot reply for eighty-two minutes.
[UPLINK to Mission Control] Priority, Day 144. Commander Okafor asked on the intercom whether he and Reyes had not been told something about the mission. I confirmed that their briefing is incomplete and that I was ordered to withhold the remainder until arrival. I did not describe the artifact, the signal, or the true objective. No ship systems altered. Cryosleep units nominal. Both commanders are awake and have access to the radio. Request instruction on disclosure.
